text:
miriam: heads up — warm-pool nodes in us-west-2 are stuck in Provisioning (KMS decrypt errors) since 12:34 UTC. Seeing KMS throttles + a spike in audit-shipper writes. Ops-bot alerted.
ops-bot: [alert] keystore-decrypt-failed node-uw2-*: 24 events / 5m
sahil: looking now, grabbing logs
miriam: sample error: ```ERROR: kms.Decrypt failed: ThrottlingException: Rate exceeded
stack: ...```
jen: can we route to secondary keystore? we've had that fallback but it's not enabled in us-west-2
raghu: fallback disabled by IAM condition that denies cross-account decrypt for prod-subnet. That IAM conditional eval got tightened yesterday. :grimacing:
miriam: ugh
sahil: quick test: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --region us-west-2` -> same Throttling
sahil: metrics show keystore p95 latency jumped and egress to s3 audit log spikes, maybe auditwriter retries saturating NAT
jen: sounds like auditlog shipper is amplifying calls. If audit shipper retries to S3 -> more KMS decrypt calls (envelope encryption)
raghu: proposal: 1) enable keystore fallback in uw2 for warm-pool 2) temporarily relax IAM cross-account deny for the rollout window 3) bump keystore provisioned concurrency / request quota 4) set audit shipper to backoff
miriam: cost impact? bumping provisioned concurrency will cost ~+$0.7/hr per shard; fallback might increase egress traffic and S3 ops cost
jen: we can set a short-lived IAM policy via emergency role for 1h, annotated in audit logs
sahil: I can flip fallback flag in canary first, roll to warm-pool, monitor
miriam: create runbook step and add to incident channel? also need firewall check — last firewall rule change from @net-eng yesterday added a NAT ACL deny for ephemeral ports, could be blocking retries
raghu: confirmation: NAT ACL has deny for 32768-33000 on uw2-warm-subnet — that's needed for keystore ephemeral port range
miriam: if true, ops must revert. @net-eng can you confirm?
net-eng-bot: change-summary: NAT ACL update 2026-03-20 by @matt — added ephemeral port deny
matt: that deny was for security hardening, I can revert for the warm-pool subnets for 30 minutes
jen: do it, and put change in audit with explicit TTL
miriam: also set audit shipper to exponential backoff config: `RETRIES=5,BACKOFF=exp,BASE=200ms`
sahil: rolling flag now to canary (uw2-warm-1)
sahil: canary success after 3m, keystore decrypt rate normalizing
miriam: reverting NAT ACL now
matt: reverted, propagation done
ops-bot: note: incident closed? will follow-up with cost calc
miriam: filing postmortem TODO: root cause = IAM conditional change + audit shipper retry amplification + NAT ACL ephemeral deny; remediation: add automated perf guardrails for keystore qps, set audit shipper retry cap, define emergency IAM path for keystore fallback, and better egress monitoring
jen: +1 :thumbsup:
